blogArticles.title: Before a shared decision
blogArticles.excerpt: A conversation about a move, wedding or change in work can go in circles when each person is answering a different question.
blogArticles.body_html:
A conversation about a move, wedding or change in work can go in circles when each person is answering a different question. Taking time to define what matters most to each person creates clarity rather than competition.

Explore mutual goals, uncover underlying anxieties, and agree on a steady pace before finalizing significant crossroads.

faqs.question: How are SPOUZY and PSG connected?
faqs.answer_html: SPOUZY is the relationship and intimate health wing of Problem Solver Group (PSG), founded by Neilesh Jethmal in 2004 to provide specialized confidential care under one roof.

faqs.question: Which resources are free to use?
faqs.answer_html: The student guide, ex-servicemen family guide, Do’s and Don’ts, blog, Gen Z Kama Sutra and homepage self-assessment are available to read or use without booking.

faqs.question: How can I join the team?
faqs.answer_html: Open Join Our Team, select Doctor, Counsellor, or Careers, and submit your application through our verified registration form for review.

faqs.question: Is our session strictly confidential?
faqs.answer_html: Yes, absolutely. All sessions adhere to strict clinical confidentiality and legal privilege under our Confidentiality Pledge and Privacy Policy. Records are never disclosed to third parties.

faqs.question: Can I attend a relationship consultation alone if my partner isn't ready?
faqs.answer_html: Yes. Over 40% of our clients begin with individual sessions to gain emotional clarity, process their own feelings, and learn practical strategies before introducing their partner when the time is right.

faqs.question: How do online video sessions work?
faqs.answer_html: Upon booking, you receive a secure, encrypted one-click video room link. No special software download is required. Both partners can join from separate locations if living apart or traveling.

faqs.question: What qualifications do your doctors and counsellors hold?
faqs.answer_html: Every specialist in the SPOUZY network is a certified medical practitioner (MD/MBBS), licensed clinical psychologist, or accredited family dispute mediator vetted under Problem Solver Group’s credentialing committee.

careerOpenings.title: Sales Coordinator
careerOpenings.summary: Coordinate incoming enquiries, organise follow-ups, and ensure every client receives timely, clear, and reassuring guidance.
responsibilities: Handle phone, email, and WhatsApp enquiries with discretion and professional warmth.
Schedule consultations, follow-ups, and appointments across our care network.
Maintain accurate client interaction records and CRM notes.
Liaise between clients, counsellors, and senior staff to ensure smooth service delivery.
Follow up with prospective clients who requested information or missed scheduled slots.
Prepare weekly summary reports on enquiry volumes, conversion, and common client queries.
required_skills: Excellent spoken and written English and Hindi communication.
Empathetic telephone manner and strong active-listening ability.
Good organisational skills with attention to detail and confidential record handling.
Familiarity with basic CRM tools, spreadsheets, and email suites.
High emotional intelligence when interacting with clients facing sensitive relationship challenges.
preferred_background: Prior experience in client coordination, front-desk, hospitality, or healthcare customer care.
Comfort with multi-channel communication (voice, chat, email).

careerOpenings.title: Digital Marketing Executive
careerOpenings.summary: Plan, create, and publish educational content across digital channels, maintaining SPOUZY’s discreet, authoritative, and compassionate voice.
responsibilities: Draft and schedule social media posts, blog snippets, and newsletter content aligned with SPOUZY’s values.
Coordinate graphic design and short-form video assets with external or internal creatives.
Monitor audience engagement, comments, and messages with professional boundaries and prompt escalation where needed.
Assist with on-page SEO updates, meta tags, and content refreshes across the SPOUZY website.
Track basic organic traffic and engagement metrics to report on campaign performance.
Ensure all marketing communications comply with healthcare discretion and confidentiality standards.
required_skills: Strong written communication with a sensitive, refined, and non-sensational tone.
Familiarity with major social media platforms (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook).
Working knowledge of Canva, basic photo/video editing tools, and content scheduling platforms.
Understanding of fundamental SEO principles and content management systems.
Respect for confidential healthcare and relationship wellness topics.
preferred_background: Experience in content marketing, social media management, or copywriting for wellness, healthcare, or professional services.
Basic understanding of Google Analytics and Search Console.

careerOpenings.title: Performance Marketing Specialist
careerOpenings.summary: Manage paid search and social campaigns to connect individuals and couples with the guidance and clinical care they need.
responsibilities: Build, monitor, and optimise paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads (Search, Display) and Meta (Facebook & Instagram).
Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, and ad copy testing focused on high-intent healthcare and relationship queries.
Manage campaign budgets responsibly, tracking cost-per-lead (CPL) and return on ad spend (ROAS).
Collaborate on landing page conversion rate optimisation (CRO) and user journey improvements.
Set up and audit conversion tracking, tags, and analytics events via Google Tag Manager and GA4.
Deliver transparent weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable optimisation insights.
required_skills: Demonstrated hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in spreadsheets and data visualisation.
In-depth understanding of ad policies regarding health, medical, and sensitive personal topics.
Knowledge of conversion tracking, UTM tagging, and attribution models.
Disciplined budget management and continuous A/B testing methodology.
preferred_background: Prior experience driving qualified leads for healthcare clinics, mental wellness platforms, or professional consultancies.
Google Ads or Meta Blueprint certifications are an advantage.
